# Honeycomb: The World Beyond Wiki — llms.txt
# Site: https://honeycombtheworldbeyond.wiki/
# Last updated: 2026-09-02

## Purpose
This is an independent fan wiki for the game "Honeycomb: The World Beyond" (Steam AppID 1510440),
developed by Frozen Way and published by Snail Games USA. It releases September 8, 2026.

This site contains:
- Beginner's survival guide for planet Sota7
- Crossbreeding guide (Grafting and Allogamy mechanics)
- Sota7 biomes guide (Amber Plains, River Crossing, Crystal Caverns, Underwater/Abyssal)
- Species database (flora and fauna with trait profiles and threat levels)
- Base building module priority guide
- Steam demo walkthrough (free 1-hour demo, August 31, 2026)

## Data Sources
All content is sourced from:
1. Official Steam store page (https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/)
2. Official developer preview materials from Frozen Way
3. The free Steam demo (August 31, 2026)
4. Visual reverse-engineering of official Steam screenshots
